_comment: Home Assistant's own MCP server, exposed to agents through aw-mcp-gateway.
DISABLED BY DEFAULT, and it has to be: HA's /api/mcp needs a long-lived
access token, that token is specific to one install, and this repo is
public — so there is nothing sensible to ship here. Enabling it is a
two-step manual edit of the INSTALLED copy of this file at
1. In Home Assistant: add the 'Model Context Protocol Server'
then create a long-lived access token from your user profile.
2. Paste it below in place of REPLACE_WITH_HA_LONG_LIVED_TOKEN, set
enabled to true, and run: aw-workspace-cli restart mcp-gateway
Caveat worth knowing before you rely on it: the installed package dir is
overwritten wholesale on every app update, so an app upgrade resets this
file back to the disabled placeholder and the HA tools disappear from the
gateway until you redo step 2. See README.md.
